data.one_liner: Plugin to send data to native home screen widgets on Android and iOS
data.what_it_does: HomeWidget provides a unified API for Flutter to communicate with native home screen widgets. It lets you save data, trigger updates, and handle interactions from the widget.
use_when: You need to display dynamic content on the device home screen
You want to update the widget from Flutter code
You need to support both Android and iOS home screen widgets
avoid_when: You want to render Flutter widgets directly on the home screen
You need a fully declarative widget system without native code
strengths: Supports custom fonts, icons, and widget previews
Handles null values and baseline alignment
weaknesses: No Flutter widgets can be rendered on the home screen
data.setup_notes: Create native widgets on Android (XML) and iOS (Swift/ObjC), register them, then call HomeWidget.saveWidgetData and HomeWidget.updateWidget from Flutter.
